governance.rule: F/R/V/W/X/Y/Z code families are comorbidity-only, never primary, never promotable, but may generate Plan of Care content when used as secondary, comorbidity, or contributing condition.

problems.label: Cardiac disease progression with activity intolerance or symptom burden

goals: Patient will remain comfortable with reduced cardiac symptom burden.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of cardiac symptom monitoring and when to notify hospice.

interventions.text: Assess edema, dyspnea, fatigue, activity tolerance and medication effectiveness.
Review cardiac decline and care plan effectiveness.

problems.label: Respiratory disease progression with dyspnea and activity intolerance

goals: Patient will remain comfortable with reduced respiratory distress.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of dyspnea management.

interventions.text: Assess respiratory status and effectiveness of interventions.
Review respiratory decline, dyspnea burden and plan of care effectiveness.

problems.label: Vascular dementia contributing to cognitive and functional decline

goals: Patient will remain safe and comfortable with support appropriate to cognitive decline.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of cognitive decline and safety needs.

interventions.text: Assess cognitive status, safety risks, functional decline and caregiver understanding.
Assess caregiver burden, coping and available support system.
Review cognitive decline, caregiver burden, safety needs and plan of care effectiveness.

problems.label: Dementia associated with another disease contributing to cognitive and functional decline

goals: Patient will remain safe and comfortable with support appropriate to cognitive decline.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of disease-related cognitive decline and care needs.

interventions.text: Assess cognitive status, communication ability, safety risks, functional decline and caregiver understanding.
Assess caregiver coping, support system and need for additional resources.
Review cognitive decline, caregiver burden, safety needs and plan of care effectiveness.

problems.label: Dementia contributing to cognitive and functional decline

goals: Patient will remain safe and comfortable.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of disease progression.

interventions.text: Assess cognitive status, safety risks and caregiver understanding.
Assess caregiver burden and support needs.
Review cognitive decline, caregiver burden, safety needs and plan of care effectiveness.

problems.label: Alzheimer's disease progression with cognitive and functional decline

goals: Patient will remain safe and comfortable with support appropriate to cognitive decline.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of dementia progression and safety needs.

interventions.text: Assess cognitive status, FAST stage when applicable, safety risks, functional decline and caregiver understanding.
Assess caregiver burden, coping, support system and need for additional resources.
Review cognitive decline, FAST stage, caregiver burden, safety needs and plan of care effectiveness.

problems.label: Senile degeneration of brain with cognitive and functional decline

goals: Patient will remain safe and comfortable with support appropriate to cognitive and functional decline.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of disease progression and care needs.

interventions.text: Assess cognitive status, safety risks, functional decline, nutrition risk and caregiver understanding.
Assess caregiver burden, coping and available support system.
Review cognitive decline, functional decline, caregiver support needs and plan of care effectiveness.

problems.label: Progressive neurologic decline associated with ALS

goals: Patient will remain safe and comfortable throughout progressive neurologic decline.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of disease progression, symptom management, and hospice support plan.

interventions.text: Assess respiratory status, swallowing ability, communication ability, mobility, safety risks, and caregiver understanding.
Assess caregiver burden, coping, support system, and psychosocial needs.
Review neurologic decline, respiratory status, nutritional status, caregiver burden, and plan of care effectiveness.

problems.label: Neurologic deficits following stroke with progressive care needs

goals: Patient will remain safe and comfortable with support appropriate to neurologic deficits.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of stroke-related care needs and safety precautions.

interventions.text: Assess mobility, communication deficits, swallowing status, safety risks and caregiver understanding.
Assess caregiver burden, coping and support system.
Review neurologic deficits, safety risks, caregiver support needs and plan of care effectiveness.

problems.label: End-stage Parkinson disease with progressive neurologic and functional decline

goals: Patient will remain safe and comfortable throughout progressive neurologic decline.
Caregiver will verbalize understanding of disease progression, fall prevention, aspiration precautions, and hospice plan of care.

interventions.text: Assess mobility, balance, swallowing status, communication ability, respiratory status, safety risks and caregiver understanding.
Assess caregiver burden, coping ability and support system.
Review neurologic decline, aspiration risk, nutrition status, caregiver support needs and plan of care effectiveness.
